status: bounded comparisons; no executable private latent loop

source.token_cohort_digest_domain: pllm.latent.token_cohort.v1\0; signed IDs encoded as 4-byte unsigned little-endian integers
source.separate_benchmark_prompt_digests: per-invocation salted; exact default CLI prompt and pinned tokenizer identify the common cohort

method.benchmarks: one warm measured response after one warmup; request-sized offline inventory; identical public prompt and W8A8 model; two co-located provider-role processes
method.compiler_projection: same 24-layer/151936-vocabulary semantic plan, 39-token prefill, one-token decode for each additional generated token
method.remote_mlp_assumption: one masked 24-bit hidden input and 32-bit hidden output per executed layer row; per-token Q7 polynomial material for both parties is counted separately
method.resident_assumption: one independent 24-bit masked MLP hidden input and one attention-query hidden input per row; attention arithmetic and protected rescale omitted
method.selection_assumption: reference-specific minimum: one 17-bit field-value multiplication per logit bit, requiring two i64 opened operands between parties, 32 bytes; actual existing reference reveals the token to the client and uses far more work

privacy_and_cost_gates: The existing compiler places greedy selection and token feedback at the client; no provider-protected selector or private selected-index lookup is admitted.
The bounded point FSS comparison handles at most 10 bits, not this 151936-token shared-index embedding lookup.
Moving output delivery to the end does not remove the token dependency; sharing the selection across workers needs a new evaluated protocol.
One-use material remains per response, even if model weights are downloaded once; repeated seeds or public low-rank masks do not satisfy the privacy boundary.
The quadratic Q7 method has no proven Qwen activation range, exact rescale, protected attention or whole-decoder parity.
Control/TLS/wire costs, separate-operator privacy, full-response cold compute and real-model quality for either proposed composition are unmeasured.
reproduction: uv run --no-sync pllm --format json benchmark run --experiment examples/benchmarks/latent_response_cohort.py:prepared --max-output-tokens 8 --warmups 1 --repetitions 1 --trust-python --inventory-policy request-sized
